rows.evidence_section: CldTypHist product guide, Data Set Description
rows.evidence_quote: Input to the CldTypHist Gridding Subsystem is the Single Scanner Footprint TOA/Surface Fluxes and Clouds (SSF) archival data product and gridded geostationary (GGEO) intermediate product.

supporting_quotes.quote: The CldTypHist product combines cloud properties from Terra-MODIS (10:30 AM local equator crossing time LECT), Aqua-MODIS (1:30 PM LECT), and geostationary satellites (GEO) to provide the most diurnally complete product.
The Meteosat 8-10 and Himawari-8 are retrieved from multiple channels (M-ch)
Met-8 and Met-9 were used as backups, when Met-10 was undergoing de-icing of its IR channels.
Cloud properties for MODIS and GEO: NASA-LaRC (Minnis) MODIS and GEO cloud property retrievals
Note: Version 1.2 is identical to version 1.0.
